title: BIfTI Phantom Registry v1
description: Immutable archive of public BIfTI phantoms (format v1 - the '-v1' in this schema's name is the version discriminator, as for the phantom schema; a backwards-incompatible change bumps it to v2). A top-level object mapping each collection name to its entry. A collection name has the fixed form '<author>-<name>-<number>' and, once merged, is frozen forever - never modified, removed, or renamed. Each collection points at one Zenodo record (by version DOI) holding one or more phantom JSON files and the NIfTI files they reference. The registry only references data; it does not store it. Tools discover collections through catalog.json (see bifti-catalog.schema.json), not by listing this file. Collections allow additional properties so the format can evolve in place. See REGISTRY.md.

collection.description: A registered Zenodo record and the phantom files it contains. The object key that maps to this entry is the collection name, of the form '<author>-<name>-<number>' (lowercase surname, a slug, and a zero-padded 3-digit number bumped for each revised or extended dataset): unique across the registry, frozen once merged, and it namespaces those files in references ('<collection>/<file>'). Its allowed form is constrained by the registry's propertyNames pattern.

description.description: One or two sentences describing the collection.

license.description: Reuse terms as an SPDX license identifier (e.g. 'CC-BY-4.0', 'CC0-1.0').

doi.description: Immutable Zenodo version DOI of the exact, byte-identical record version this collection currently points to (e.g. '10.5281/zenodo.1234568'). The DOI embeds the Zenodo record id ('zenodo.<id>'), so it alone is enough to resolve and download the files; no provider or URL is stored.

phantoms.description: The phantom JSON filenames inside the Zenodo record (one per configuration, e.g. one per field strength), optionally organized into nested groups. Each filename is referenced as '<collection>/<filename>' regardless of nesting depth; the NIfTI files a phantom needs live in the same record.

phantomEntry.description: Either a phantom JSON filename, or a named group nesting further phantom entries.

phantomGroup.description: A named, purely organizational grouping of phantom entries. Carries no file of its own; 'phantoms' may again mix filenames and further groups, so nesting is unlimited.

description.description: Optional one-sentence description of the group.

default.description: Optional filename (from within this group, at any depth) to use when a single representative phantom is needed.

phantoms.description: The filenames and/or nested groups belonging to this group.

email.description: Optional contact email for the author.
